luiskr.com / core/utils/canvas/widgets/theme-slider / ThemeSliderWebGL

Defined in: core/utils/canvas/widgets/theme-slider.ts:31

Full Animated Day/Night/System Theme Slider Powered by WebGL with robust Canvas 2D fallback. Uses normalized aspect coordinates (range 0.0 to 3.33) to prevent GPU float overflow on all platforms. Position 0: Dark (Night - Lunar moon with craters, twinkling stars, starry canyon mesas) Position 1: System (Twilight - Balanced orb, sun rings rising on left, crescent on right) Position 2: Light (Day - Sun knob on right, peach/coral sky, radiant sun on left)
